Rationale: the derived 「+ 添加」 picker on a plain-lookup related tab ignores the child lookup's `dependsOn`, so it offers other accounts' unlinked records, and its first column 「NAME」 renders empty. A wrong link needs a person to pick the wrong row, and nothing is changed silently, so this is p2. It is a sibling of p1 #36659 (closed), whose picker queried the wrong object outright. Found live while verifying PR #36704.
